name: @muxos/plugin-primitives-networking-background-loads
description: Background loads yield to what the visitor waits on: holdBackgroundLoads() is taken while the visitor watches a download they asked for (the live demo's Enter), and startBackgroundLoad(start) — a download the page starts on its own, ahead of any ask (an idle code preload) — waits until the last hold is released. backgroundLoadsHeld / subscribeBackgroundLoads read it live (a video's metadata preload). A load already in flight is never recalled.
